newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon Electronics soars on forecast revision.
newsitem.headline: Canon Electronics soars on forecast revision.

text.p: Shares of Canon Electronics Inc jumped on Tuesday afternoon, hitting their daily limit on an upward revision in the firm's six-month earnings forecast which was announced on the previous day, brokers said.
As of 0530 GMT, the shares of the camera unit and magnetic head producer were up 100 yen at 1,010, a level which was also a high for calendar 1997.
On Monday, Canon Electronics said it expected a parent current profit of 1.00 billion yen in the six months to June 30, 1997, up from an earlier forecast of 600 million yen.
